messages.text: So what to I get for Maryland 21740?

For Maryland, top native milkweeds are:

Swamp milkweed (Asclepias incarnata), best overall; sun, average-to-wet soils, rain gardens.

Butterfly weed (Asclepias tuberosa), best for dry, well-drained sunny spots.

Common milkweed (Asclepias syriaca), excellent for monarchs but spreads, best for larger areas.

We have all of them here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden
